name: UpToDate
one_liner: Evidence-based clinical decision support used by 2M+ clinicians with peer-reviewed recommendations at the point of care ($579/year).
short_description: UpToDate is the leading evidence-based clinical decision support resource providing peer-reviewed recommendations for diagnosis and treatment decisions.
long_description: UpToDate is the leading evidence-based clinical decision support system used by over 2 million clinicians in 190+ countries. Published by Wolters Kluwer, it provides peer-reviewed, continuously updated clinical recommendations written by physician-authors and editors. Topics cover nearly every medical specialty including psychiatry, psychology, and mental health conditions. Individual subscriptions cost $579/year for US physicians with discounts for students and trainees. Enterprise subscriptions are available for hospitals and health systems. The UpToDate suite includes UpToDate (core clinical content), UpToDate Lexidrug (drug information, formerly Lexicomp), UpToDate Patient Engagement (patient education), and UpToDate Expert AI for clinically grounded AI-assisted decision support. Studies have linked UpToDate use to improved patient outcomes and reduced hospital lengths of stay.
best_for: Psychiatrists and mental health providers making treatment decisions
Medical residents and students studying clinical medicine
Health systems wanting standardized clinical references
not_for: Those wanting free clinical references (use Medscape/Epocrates)
International clinicians without budget for subscription

pricing.notes: 30-day money-back guarantee for new annual subscriptions. Multi-year discounts available. Free access for clinicians in underserved areas through global health programs.

compliance.notes: Clinical reference tool—does not store patient data. Content peer-reviewed and continuously updated.

integrations.name: EHR Systems
integrations.notes: Integrates with major EHR systems for point-of-care access

seo.title: UpToDate: Evidence-Based Clinical Decision Support
seo.meta_description: UpToDate is the leading clinical decision support tool used by 2M+ clinicians. $579/year. Evidence-based treatment recommendations. AI-assisted support.

faqs.a: UpToDate costs $579/year for individual US physicians. Student and trainee discounts are available with proof of status. Enterprise pricing requires contacting sales.

Studies have linked UpToDate use to improved patient outcomes and reduced hospital lengths of stay. Over 2 million clinicians use it globally, making it the industry standard for clinical decision support.

faqs.q: Does UpToDate cover psychiatry and mental health?
faqs.a: Yes, UpToDate includes comprehensive coverage of psychiatry, psychology, and mental health topics including depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, and psychopharmacology.

faqs.q: Does UpToDate have an AI feature?
faqs.a: Yes, UpToDate Expert AI provides AI-assisted clinical decision support. It's included in select subscription types and availability varies by region.

company_info.notes: UpToDate is the world's most widely used clinical decision support resource, used in 190+ countries by 2M+ clinicians.
